# Background Pattern

`decorative/background-pattern` &middot; section-level &middot; category: decorative

## Purpose

A section with a repeating pattern or texture image behind its content, with a solid-color fallback.

## Required fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `pattern` | url |  |
| `content` | components (content-level) |  |

## Optional fields

None.

## Variants

Same data and structure, different styling. Pick one with `{ variant: 'name' }`.

- **default**: Tiled pattern.
- **cover**: One image stretched to cover the section. Sets `repeat: no-repeat`, `size: cover`.

## Settings

Every setting has a default. Values may be token references (`@colors.accent`, `@theme.card.radius`). Pass overrides with `{ settings: { ... } }`.

| Setting | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `hideOnMobile` | boolean | `false` |
| `hideOnDesktop` | boolean | `false` |
| `background` | color | `"@colors.background"` |
| `repeat` | one of `repeat`, `no-repeat`, `repeat-x`, `repeat-y` | `"repeat"` |
| `size` | text | `"auto"` |
| `padding` | spacing | `"@theme.section.paddingY @theme.section.paddingX"` |

## Responsive behavior

- `hideOnMobile`: hides it below 480px. Outlook desktop and Gmail on non-Google accounts ignore media queries and still show it.
- `hideOnDesktop`: shows it only on phones. Clients that ignore media queries keep it hidden.

## Compatibility

| Outlook desktop | Gmail apps | Dark mode |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Background image via MJML VML fallback. | Background images can be blocked, the solid color shows instead. | Keeps its own colors, it is a branded block. |



## Example usage

This is a section-level component: use it directly in an email body or a recipe.

In an email (`.mjml`):

```
[[ c('decorative/background-pattern', {
  "pattern": "https://placehold.co/120x120/EEEEEE/DDDDDD/png?text=%C2%B7",
  "content": [
    {
      "component": "content/heading",
      "data": {
        "text": "Refer a friend, get $20"
      },
      "settings": {
        "level": "h2",
        "align": "center"
      }
    },
    {
      "component": "content/text",
      "data": {
        "text": "Give a friend $20 off their first order and get $20 when they buy."
      },
      "settings": {
        "align": "center"
      }
    }
  ]
}) ]]
```

As data (a node, for recipes and the remix API):

```json
{
  "component": "decorative/background-pattern",
  "data": {
    "pattern": "https://placehold.co/120x120/EEEEEE/DDDDDD/png?text=%C2%B7",
```
